title: metadata-protocol, plugin-security: the managed seal and the packaged permission-set lock judge a permission set by name alone, so one package's save of its own set N is refused because another package ships N
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUcj2x2Wr4UErwBi12

Filing gate: ① a product defect with a named location, measured. Found by area S5's dev on #32780 (report 6904857828, out_of_scope_findings, class b), filed by area S5 (E1b), lease E1.

## 维护者速读

- 问题：包 crm 在代码里发布了权限集 N，另一个命名空间的包 hr 保存它自己的权限集 N 时，被拒绝，提示"由托管包提供并已封存"。
- 影响：ADR-0150 D2 规定权限集按 (包, 名字) 区分，但封存和锁只看名字，把别的包的同名集当成自己的封存基线，误拒了合法保存。
- 修法方向：封存判断和打包权限集锁改为按 (包, 名字) 判断，只拦截对同一个包所发布集合的覆盖。
- 优先级 p2，本区（S5）处理，涉及 plugin-security 的部分需和 S1 区核对。

## Measured

This was measured in a pin attempt on the #32780 branch (PR #34224). Package crm (namespace crm) registers permission set N in code. Package hr (namespace hr) then saves its own permission set N through the public save door `saveMetaItem`. The save is refused with `Metadata item permission/N is provided by a managed package and is sealed`.

Seams (read):
- `packages/metadata-protocol` save path `refusePackagedBaseOverride` (the managed seal, ADR-0126 / ADR-0131 D6).
- `packages/plugin-security` `registerPackagedPermissionSetLockGate`.

Both key on the name alone.

## Acceptance

1. A save of package P's own permission set N is not refused because another package Q ships N, in both registration orders. A save that overrides Q's shipped N (bare, or addressed to Q, or addressed to Q's customization pair, whatever the pair's namespace) is still sealed or locked exactly as today. Pin and ablate both arms, and add a pin for the save addressed to Q's pair.
2. Check the other package-scoped metadata types that the seal judges, and say in the PR which ones share the name-wide shape.
3. Declare the FROM→TO with its Clause-② arm. A refused save becoming accepted is a widening.

Prior rulings read:
- ADR-0150 D2 (a permission set is (package, name)) and red line 2.
- ADR-0126 / ADR-0131 D6 (the managed seal). The fix keeps the seal for a package's own shipped base.
- PR #34224 (#32780), which keeps stored sets per package in the registry and leaves this door unchanged.

## Dedupe

I searched for "managed package and is sealed" permission, `refusePackagedBaseOverride` and `registerPackagedPermissionSetLockGate`. The only hit was #32780 itself, whose dev report names this finding as out of scope.

Amended by area S5 on the server#5 seat's reading (review-c note on PR #34224, record 6907092747): acceptance item 1 now also keeps a save addressed to the shipper's customization pair sealed as an override of the shipped set.
